<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 Da, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely is C₇H₁₂N₂O (exact mass 140.09496 Da), which is within the typical experimental tolerance for a single‑charge ESI measurement.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12N2O</final_answer>
